summary: Mergeable with minor issues related to code style and documentation.

issues.description: The patch introduces a minor style inconsistency by adding an extra blank line between the for loop and the if statement.
The patch does not include additional tests to cover the parallelization of k-means runs.
The patch could benefit from additional comments to explain the reasoning behind the parallelization of k-means runs.
The patch uses a different naming convention for the seed variable, which is slightly inconsistent with the rest of the codebase.
